name: Four Seasons Hotel Marrakech
insider_take: This palatial oasis sits in the heart of Morocco's Red City, where ancient traditions meet modern luxury beneath the snow-capped Atlas Mountains.
whats_special: The hotel features authentic Moroccan architecture with hand-carved cedar ceilings and zellige tilework, plus the largest hotel pool in Marrakech at 1,200 square meters. The property overlooks the historic Menara Gardens, a 12th-century olive grove that's a UNESCO World Heritage site candidate.
pro_tip: Book a traditional hammam treatment at the spa, then catch sunset from the rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Atlas Mountains and Koutoubia Mosque.
dont_miss: The evening call to prayer echoing across the city from nearby mosques, shopping for handwoven Berber carpets in the ancient Jemaa el-Fnaa square (10 minutes away), and dining at the hotel's rooftop restaurant where you can see the pink sandstone walls that give Marrakech its "Red City" nickname.
pros: Stunning traditional Moroccan architecture with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional spa services featuring authentic Moroccan treatments
Multiple dining venues including rooftop restaurant with Atlas Mountain views
Prime location in Hivernage district near Medina and major attractions
cons: Busy location in tourist district can be crowded during peak season
